attchmntText: Gillanders Arbuthnot & Company Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gillanders Arbuthnot and Company Limited approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13th November, 2026. For the half year ended 30th September, 2026, the company reported total revenue from operations of Rs. 19,118.93 lakhs and a profit before tax of Rs. 2,181.99 lakhs. The profit for the period was Rs. 2,111.55 lakhs. Earnings per equity share stood at Rs. 9.95. The company opted for the New Tax Regime at a rate of 22% effective from 1st April, 2026. The results were reviewed by M/s. JKVS & Co., Chartered Accountants.
